youtube.baslik: Why does half a millisecond between the ears matter? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In neurodiagnostic ABR, wave V latencies of the two ears are compared at the same intensity. In this example, they are 5.6 ms on the right and 6.1 ms on the left, a difference of 0.5 ms. A difference above about 0.3 to 0.4 ms is usually considered abnormal; the finding is not a diagnosis, and the person is referred to a physician for further evaluation.
